full_judgment: 2. The facts relevant to the disposal of the Rule, in short, is that the present opposite party No.1 Makhon Chandra Sarker as pre-emptor filed an application under section 96 of the East Bengal Acquisition and Tenancy Act, 1950 (in short, the EB SA&T Act) to pre-empt 0.05 acres of land which were sold by his full brother Madhob Chandra Sarker, the opposite party No.3 to Dinesh Chandra Mandal by a kabala dated 29-9-2005. It may be noticed here that by the said kabala total 0.14 acres of land were sold. The rest 0.09 acres of land were purchased by Jadob Chandra Sarker, the full brother of the seller who is opposite party No. 2 in the original application later on became the co-petitioner and now the Rule petitioner.
